title: Let your AI agents paint big arrows, boxes and text on your screen
summary: A JavaScript library that enables AI agents to draw visual overlays including arrows, boxes, and text directly on the user's screen to provide visual guidance and direction during interactions.
problem_solved: AI agents communicating only through text or voice can be confusing and lack spatial context - this tool adds visual指了指能力让AI代理能够直观地指向屏幕上的具体元素。
why_valuable: Creates a more intuitive human-AI interaction by adding visual spatial guidance that makes agent instructions immediately clear and actionable.
